data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What should I do if my boss fires me? ASSISTANT:

If your boss fires you, it is natural to feel shock and disappointment. It is important to remember that you have rights as an employee, and you should contact an employment lawyer to understand your options. You may be eligible for severance pay or unemployment benefits, and an attorney can help you understand your rights and next steps. Additionally, it may be helpful to reach out to a counselor or friend for support during this time.
